name: DateRangePicker
summary: Combines two ISO date fields with a range calendar chooser.

obligations: Expose start and end dates and the calendar trigger.
Keep the range calendar and focused dates keyboard accessible.

behavior: Controlled and uncontrolled values are supported.
Keyboard input preserves the native accessible interaction model.
Min/max date bounds are inclusive; controlled and default out-of-range values remain visible and invalid.
Range unavailable callbacks receive serialized date and nullable anchor strings while preserving contiguous range selection.
Open state is independently controlled with open/defaultOpen and onOpenChange; defaultOpen is false.
Built-in invalid presentation follows the owning Form validationBehavior; name-keyed external errors are exposed immediately.
accessibility: Expose start and end dates and the calendar trigger.
Keep the range calendar and focused dates keyboard accessible.

requirements.reason: Native dynamic colors do not apply to the React web binding.
Native font metrics do not apply to the React web binding.
